title: Qualification policy v4: pre-registered waves, replication and discovery evidence classes, investable co-primary cell (tier-1 v2)
authority: tier-1 v2 S1 node 1.10 brief; rulings R-6 (wave pre-registration: catalog rows and this policy hash frozen before a wave reads any return, cumulative trial registry, holdout opened once and only on final labels), R-7 (published signals are replications with a one-sided test, conjectures and composites are discoveries with HLZ + DSR, an investable co-primary cell must pass), C-24 (value-weight market beta and FF-residual ivol are the tested hypotheses; equal-weight twins are reported only), C-25 (two-sided rows carry no pre-registered sign: discovery gate, excluded from signed composites and reported separately), C-22/C-34 (the composite null-simulation evidence stays with node 4.4). Frozen before any tier-1 v2 wave read a forward return; the r4-qualification-v3 file remains the legacy R3b/R4 DuckDB-oracle policy (R-5).

evaluation_inputs.meaning: gate-feeding R3b EvaluationSpec values; a run whose spec differs on any of them, or that did not evaluate the investable slice, the Jegadeesh-Titman holdings and population coverage, is refused. Build the spec with qualification.evaluation_spec_kwargs_v4(policy)

evidence_classes.replication: a published anomaly or analogue with a pre-registered sign: one-sided EWC test in that direction
evidence_classes.discovery: an economic conjecture, a two-sided row (no pre-registered sign) or a composite: the two-sided HLZ hurdle; a signed conjecture must clear it in its pre-registered direction (clearing it in the opposite direction is sign_reversed), a two-sided row fixes its realized sign

grade_basis.provisional_labels: selection sample only, the holdout stays sealed; statuses stop at selection_pass
grade_basis.final_labels: the holdout is graded only after trial_registry.open_holdout(wave) recorded the wave's one opening

reported_only.rule: ruling C-24: the equal-weight-market twins of the value-weight market beta (beta_mkt_252d) and the FF-residual idiosyncratic volatility (ivol_252d) are evaluated and reported, never gated; they stay out of the gating family and count as trials. A wave may register further reported-only rows at registration, before any return is read.

two_sided_rows: ruling C-25: graded under the discovery gate (two-sided); excluded from signed composites and reported separately

methods.significance: EWC fixed-b (stats.mean_inference, horizon_periods = 3) on the primary cell's per-formation rank IC over the selection sample; p = the robust Student-t p-value; one-sided p in direction d = p/2 when d*t > 0, else 1 - p/2; |z| = the normal-equivalent z of the two-sided p
methods.gating_bh: Benjamini-Hochberg per basis over the gating family: the primary cells of this wave's research-eligible, not reported-only hypotheses, each at its evidence class p-value (replication one-sided in the pre-registered direction, discovery two-sided), plus p = 1 for every gating hypothesis of every earlier registered wave (trial registry); an untested gating cell enters as p = 1
methods.dsr: deflated Sharpe probability of the direction-oriented ls_ew10 series of the primary cell (horizon_periods = 3), n_trials = trial_registry.trials_so_far() at grading, sharpe_variance = the cross-cell variance of the wave's tested cells at the primary horizon
methods.sign_reversed: replication: one-sided p against the pre-registered sign <= one_sided_p_max; signed discovery: |z| >= hlz_abs_z_min against the pre-registered sign
methods.investable: rank IC re-ranked among names with price >= min_price_usd and market cap >= the NYSE min_me_percentile_nyse percentile at the formation (supplied NYSE breakpoints, else point-in-time NYSE names; formations with neither are excluded and counted); one-sided p in the fixed direction; no investable IC over >= min_formations formations is insufficient evidence
methods.size_buckets: replication only: the small and the large NYSE 20/50 size bucket IC means keep the pre-registered sign; NYSE buckets (supplied NYSE breakpoints, else point-in-time NYSE names) where both have >= min_formations formations, else the labeled cap-tercile fallback; a bucket without min_formations formations is insufficient evidence
methods.coverage_share: share of the feature's history-eligible selection formations whose value coverage of the catalog population is >= min_share; history-eligible = on or after the first formation recorded for the feature at wave registration (its minimum history after its source's first observation), else every selection formation; fewer than evaluation_inputs.min_formations history-eligible selection formations is insufficient coverage
methods.holdout_shrink_test: sign consistent: d * holdout IC mean > 0; shrink: t = d*(m_holdout - m_selection)/sqrt(se_holdout^2 + se_selection^2) with EWC standard errors and Welch-Satterthwaite df; one-sided p = P(T <= t); passes when p >= shrink_test_one_sided_p_min
methods.long_horizon: Jegadeesh-Titman calendar-time EW decile long-short: the month-t return averages the cohorts formed at t-1 ... t-K (one-month labels); months with all K cohorts enter the EWC test (horizon_periods = 1); reported, never gating
methods.resolution: one status per feature: a basis that qualifies or passes selection while another basis is sign_reversed makes the feature unstable; else the strict basis status when it qualifies, else the reference research basis (reconstructed) status
